question: How should one act when the time for the after-sacrifice is available, and what exception is noted?
premises: One should strive for the time of the after-sacrifice when it becomes available.
A special lunar-mansion and planetary time is relevant to this practice.
No such special time occurs in the month of Ashvayuj, so that month is excluded.
inference: The after-sacrifice should be pursued whenever its proper time is available, except in Ashvayuj where the special timing does not occur.
uncertainties: The reason Ashvayuj lacks any such special time is not explained in this verse.
plain_english: When the proper time for the after-sacrifice is available, one should make every effort to use it. But in the month of Ashvayuj there is no such special lunar-mansion and planetary time, so that month is excluded.
